sections.label: The operator
sections.statement: The discipline of a global brand, <t>built one market at a time.</t>
body: A career that began in strategy, at Ernst & Young, Cordial Business Advisers and Telia, and moved into fitness in 2009 with Health & Fitness Nordic, the group behind SATS, as director of strategy and business development. In 2016 came Barry’s: CEO of Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic in Stockholm, and a decade of taking the brand into new markets with local partners.

Today a partner in the Barry’s companies in the Nordics, Iberia and Switzerland; founding partner of Stockholm Leisure Partners, an investor in health and fitness; and, since 2026, a board member of Svensk Innebandy and AIK.

sections.label: The defining work
sections.title: Barry’s, <t>market by market.</t>
sections.body: The boutique fitness brand from Los Angeles came to Sweden through Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic, with Johan Nilsson as CEO from 2016. Studios followed in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Copenhagen; in January 2022 the company merged with the Norwegian franchisee into what the trade press called the region’s largest boutique fitness operator. Since then: partnerships in Spain and Switzerland, and a first studio in Finland.
